meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以直接操控一个浏览器:打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取数据。它会按指令逐步操作网页,并返回截图、页面内容或操作结果。
howto.when: 当用户需要浏览网站、与网页交互、填写表单等,或要测试 Web 应用、提取网页信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存。
say.note: 会打开网页并截取当前视图。

say.text: 获取当前页面的标题和网址。
在登录框填入用户名和密码并提交。
say.note: 自动填表并点击提交按钮。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can directly control a browser: open pages, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data. It performs these actions step by step and returns screenshots, page content, or operation results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to browse websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, etc., or wants to test web applications or extract information from pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Opens the page and captures the current view.

say_en.text: Get the title and URL of the current page.
say_en.note: Returns the page title and URL.

say_en.text: Fill in the username and password in the login form and submit.
say_en.note: Fills the form and clicks submit.
